entities.summary: Władysław Ewaryst Plater was a Polish count, patriot, insurrectionist, and a cousin of Emilia Plater. Together with Agaton Giller, he founded the Polish National Museum in Rapperswil, Switzerland. Brother of Cezary Plater and cousin of Emilia Plater.
